name: Read Framework Health Sensors
description: Run every framework-health sensor registered in docs/agent-system/FRAMEWORK_HEALTH.md and report each one's observed value against its deadband, with the actuator named for any sensor out of band. Covers operating-model contract validity, contract-mode coverage, graph/runtime drift, topic-flow declaration integrity, member-document conformance, prose/declaration coherence, cross-team coupling, and skill reachability. Read-only: it measures and reports, and changes nothing.

report.description: Per-sensor report. Each sensor prints its observed value, its deadband, and — when out of band — the actuator work type that owns the fix.

examples.description: Read every framework-health sensor before deciding what to audit this heartbeat.
